pptx-browser 4.1.5 — MIT licensed, zero-dependency PPTX canvas renderer.
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pptx-browser

EduPlay vendors the published ES module source locally. The only local edit is
in src/fonts.js: loadGoogleFontsFor() is a no-op so no external font request is
made; system font fallbacks are used instead. The original license is included
as LICENSE.

The original uploaded .pptx file is passed directly to PptxRenderer, so themes,
layouts, master inheritance, images and text are drawn from the source deck.
